sources.title: Contrastive learning approach | AI Research Papers
sources.snippet: Contrastive learning is a self-supervised technique where AI models learn by comparing and contrasting different data points. The core idea is to train a model to recognize similar (positive) pairs of data as being closer together in a learned representation space, while dissimilar (negative) pairs are pushed further apart.
